import json, urllib.request, urllib.error, uuid

BASE = "https://api.ivxholding.com"

def call(method, path, body=None, timeout=45):
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{BASE}{path}",
        data=json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json"}, method=method)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read() or b"{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        try: return e.code, json.loads(e.read() or b"{}")
        except Exception: return e.code, {}

results = []

# 1. Landing page live
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen("https://www.ivxholding.com", timeout=25) as r:
        html = r.read().decode(errors="ignore")
    results.append(("Landing page live (HTTP 200)", r.status == 200))
except Exception:
    results.append(("Landing page live (HTTP 200)", False))

# 2. Register a real new member (full valid payload)
email = f"iperez4242+qasignin{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}@gmail.com"
pw = "QaSignIn2026Test!"
code, reg = call("POST", "/api/members/register", {
    "email": email, "password": pw, "firstName": "QA", "lastName": "SignInCheck",
    "phone": "+13055550177", "acceptTerms": True, "dateOfBirth": "1991-03-22",
    "gender": "prefer_not_to_say", "roles": ["investor"], "country": "US", "zipCode": "33101"})
results.append((f"Registration end-to-end (HTTP {code})", code == 200 and reg.get("ok") is True))

# 3. New member signs in immediately
code2, login = call("POST", "/api/members/login", {"email": email, "password": pw})
tok = login.get("token") or login.get("accessToken") or (login.get("session") or {}).get("access_token")
results.append((f"New member sign-in w/ session token (HTTP {code2})", code2 == 200 and bool(tok)))

# 4. Owner sign-in
code3, ol = call("POST", "/api/members/login", {"email": "iperez4242@gmail.com", "password": "X146corp@1x146corp$$1"})
otok = ol.get("token") or ol.get("accessToken") or (ol.get("session") or {}).get("access_token")
results.append((f"Owner sign-in (HTTP {code3})", code3 == 200 and bool(otok)))

# 5. Wrong password rejected
code4, _ = call("POST", "/api/members/login", {"email": email, "password": "WrongPass!999"})
results.append((f"Wrong password rejected (HTTP {code4})", code4 == 401))

# 6. Invalid registration rejected (validation active)
code5, bad = call("POST", "/api/members/register", {"email": "not-an-email", "password": "x"})
results.append((f"Invalid registration rejected (HTTP {code5})", code5 == 400))

for name, ok in results:
    print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} — {name}")
print(f"SCORE: {sum(1 for _, ok in results if ok)}/{len(results)}")
open("/tmp/qa-signin-email.txt", "w").write(email)
PYEOF
